# prime-progressbar

prime-rs: ProgressBar component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/progressbar) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-progressbar) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/progressbar.md)

ProgressBar - port of `p-progressbar` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup and classes as in PrimeNG: root `div.p-progressbar[role=progressbar]` (instead of the `<p-progressbar>` host); in
`determinate` mode inside it `div.p-progressbar-value` (width by value) with `div.p-progressbar-label`, in `indeterminate` mode -
only `div.p-progressbar-value`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_progressbar::ProgressBar;

let html = view! { <ProgressBar value=50.0 /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-progressbar-determinate") && html.contains("width: 50%") && html.contains(r#"aria-valuenow="50""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-progressbar = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["progressbar"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
